summary: Wrote a 3-phase, 3.5-hour implementation plan for the three untested FormalSystem module groups: Phase 1 adds Tests/BimodalTest/Semantics/NomicLanguageTest.lean for group (A), Phase 2 adds Tests/BimodalTest/ForMathlib/SmokeTest.lean importing only FormalSystem.ForMathlib for group (B), Phase 3 folds the two uncovered Tactic/Attr.lean simp sets into NormalizationTest.lean and the five Tactic/Meta.lean helpers into LemmaDBTest.lean for group (C), then reconciles the test READMEs and verifies the tree. The plan honours the recorded prior decision: no FormalSystem path appears in any phase's file list, and buildContextExpr is probed by #check only, with both pre-validated repairs recorded as a follow-up. Plan authoring corrected one research-report-adjacent error: typst/generated/status.typ carries tests-file-count and tests-line-count, so the commit-blocking count surface IS in play for a Tests/-only change and is now declared and regenerated in every phase.
